top_findings.title: HTTP layer uses Cowboy 1.x API against declared cowboy 2.10.0 — no endpoint serves at runtime
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api_routes.erl:19 -behaviour(cowboy_http_handler) (absent in 2.x); :44 init/2 returns 2-tuple {ok,#{}} but 2.x requires {ok,Req,State}; :47 handle/2 never called by 2.x; :64,97 cowboy_req:body/1 and :81 cowboy_req:query_params/1 undefined in 2.x. rebar.config:2 = {cowboy,"2.10.0"}. grep src/ for read_body/reply/parse_qs/cowboy_handler = NONE. Compiles but crashes per request.
top_findings.suggestion: Rewrite as a Cowboy 2.x cowboy_handler: init(Req,State) that reads body via cowboy_req:read_body/1, parses qs via cowboy_req:parse_qs/1, and calls cowboy_req:reply/4 with {ok,Req,State}.

top_findings.title: No HTTP status codes set — 201/400/404 absent, all differentiation is in JSON body
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api_routes.erl:47-55 handle/2 only calls cowboy_req:set_resp_header/3 + set_resp_body/2, never cowboy_req:reply/4. create/duplicate/validation-error/not_found all return the same status; error info lives only in the JSON body. grep of src/ for reply/status/201/404/400 finds only JSON body fields and gen_server {reply,...} tuples.
top_findings.suggestion: Use cowboy_req:reply(201,...) on create, 400 on validation failure, 404 on not_found, 200 otherwise.
